name: io.github.whatevercat-creator/crypto-sentiment-x402
title: Crypto News Sentiment (x402)
description: Crypto news sentiment for 24 coins: label, score and headlines behind it, paid per call via x402

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase Developer Platform API key ID (portal.cdp.coinbase.com). Used to sign x402 payments from your own wallet. Only needed for the paid tools (get_sentiment, get_sentiment_history, get_movers); the free tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase Developer Platform API key secret, paired with CDP_API_KEY_ID. Only needed for the paid tools (get_sentiment, get_sentiment_history, get_movers); the free tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_WALLET_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name of the CDP wallet to create/reuse for payments. Defaults to "crypto-sentiment-mcp-wallet". Must hold USDC (+ a little ETH for gas) on the configured network.

environmentVariables.name: SENTIMENT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the deployed sentiment API. Defaults to https://crypto-sentiment-x402.onrender.com.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: "mainnet" (default, real USDC on Base) or "testnet" (free Base Sepolia USDC).

environmentVariables.name: SENTIMENT_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: payTo address the paid tools expect in the 402; anything else is refused before signing. Defaults to the hosted API's wallet. Set it when SENTIMENT_API_URL points at your own deployment.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_USD_PER_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Most this server signs for in total per run, in USD. Default 0.50; 0 turns the cap off. A paid call that would go over it is refused and not charged. Resets when the server restarts.
